2026-11-24.headline: Claude Code adds cloud Code Mode, Codex links threads, and Devin updates MCP and sessions
bullets: Claude Code 2.1.331 adds Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS.
Codex CLI 0.172.0 lets you follow thread links from search results and transcripts to open saved conversations and nested agents in the terminal.
Devin adds split-pane sessions via Option/Alt+click, moves session search to Cmd/Ctrl+K, and adds Run now to the Automations right-click menu.
Devin now lets you allow an MCP tool for a whole session, binds API-key MCP headers to secrets, and defaults custom MCP servers to Automatic authentication.

2026-11-25.headline: Codex extends free Sites hosting; Devin adds threat-modeled scans
bullets: Codex: Sites hosting is now free through Jan 31, 2027 (extended from Dec 31, 2026); in-app usage starts Jan 1, and Plus/Pro/Business overage billing begins Feb 1, 2027.
Devin: Split security scans now build a threat model first before launching one scan per repository.
Claude Code: Invoke MCP server skills (beta) via server:skill in the / menu, and use the PreSkillShellCommand hook to block inline shell commands in skills.
Devin: Bots now have an Auto-approve automations toggle (with enterprise admin override), plus a new Engineering pulse App template for PR and CI metrics.
Devin: Typing $ in MCP headers now suggests saved secrets, and Cmd+K adds category tabs (All, Sessions, Bots, Apps, Actions) and left-rail page results.

2026-11-26.headline: Devin adds Browser element picker, faster repo clones, and PR review updates
bullets: Devin: Use the element picker directly inside Devin Apps opened in a session's Browser tab.
Devin: Add clone.filter (e.g., blob:none or tree:none) to environment blueprints for faster blobless or treeless repo clones.
Devin: The full Devin Review PR page now includes a Fixes tab listing code-scan findings resolved by the pull request.
Devin: Jira Rovo @Devin sessions now apply configured playbooks (like !triage) and ingest work item attachments.
Devin: Failed MCP OAuth client-credentials token requests now show the endpoint, HTTP status, error code, and IP allowlisting docs.
